name: Camp Claire
description_short: Camp Claire in Lyme, CT runs a residential (overnight) camp for ages 8 to 14 and a day camp for ages 7 to 14, plus Leader in Training and Counselor in Training programs for teens. Activities include sailing, canoeing and kayaking on Hamburg Cove, swimming, archery, fishing, low ropes and campcraft. Dates and prices for 2027 have not been posted yet.
activities: CampCraft (fire building, outdoor cooking, orienteering, shelters)
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers take a swim assessment, then structured morning lessons and afternoon free swim in the pool, with at least 1 lifeguard per 10 campers. Canoeing and kayaking are on the Eight Mile River in Hamburg Cove; sailing (age 10+) needs a camper who can swim 2 pool laps nonstop.
